scope: Reproduced software blockers in exact-kernel generic VM; physical failed-trial boot stage remains unknown

findings.confirmed: Generic O_DIRECTORY65536 is ARM64 O_DIRECT; directory open reproducibly returnsEINVAL(-22). Generic O_NOFOLLOW131072 is ARM64 O_LARGEFILE, not nofollow.
findings.correction: Pinned ARM64 overrides directory16384/nofollow32768; validator applies override-before-fallback and rejects prior values.

findings.confirmed: Exact old policy VM audit denies console write, kmsg read and/dev directory write with rootfs_t labels.
findings.correction: Verify three exact static objects/device numbers; set valid explicit labels/readback under enforcing policy, no forced context/MAC_ADMIN.

findings.confirmed: Pinned SELinux hooks do not select per-path GENFS handling for configfs. Corrected VM operations use real uniform configfs_t label.
findings.correction: Permit required operations on isolated USB-only configfs with empty gadget namespace and unchanged fixed-path mutating adapters.

findings.confirmed: Longer VM sees kernel-worker fork denial under shared kernel_t. Pinned kernel maps initial userspace SID to kernel_t without newer unsupported policycap.
findings.correction: One-way checked LSM self-context transition to init_t, readback/enforcement verification; kernel worker fork allowed, PID1 fork/escape forbidden; proc stays read-only.
